message: 初めての約束

name: Synn
message: 「I'm home~」

name: Synn
message: 「Upsy-daisy.」

name: Sally
message: 「Mumble, mumble. I can't eat another bite~」

name: Paqy
message: 「Sheesh. Blissfully ignorant without a care in the world, isn't she.」

name: Synn
message: 「She was running around a ton and worked hard helping out, so she must be exhausted.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Fair enough.」

name: Synn
message: 「Goodnight, Sally-chan.」

name: Sally
message: 「Prez. Seconds~」

name: Synn
message: 「Hahaha, I told you there aren't any seconds left.」

name: Synn
message: 「Hm? The phone's ringing.」

name: Synn
message: 「Hello, Grand Palace Sakura.」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-kun? It's me, Ria.」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, hey, good evening.」

name: Ria
message: 「Sorry for calling so late at night. I figured you might already be asleep, though.」

name: Synn
message: 「No, no, I'm still too pumped up to sleep, so don't worry about it. Anyway, what's up?」

name: Ria
message: 「It's about that favor I mentioned today.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah. Oh! Right, what about it?」

name: Ria
message: 「Tomorrow's your day off. Do you have any plans, Synn-kun?」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? No, nothing in particular.」

name: Ria
message: 「I see. Thank goodness♪ In that case, tomorrow--」

name: Ria
message: 「Let's go out together.\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh!?」

name: Ria
message: 「KiraFes wrapped up without a hitch, too. Since we have the chance, I figured sooner would be better.」

name: Synn
message: 「Th-That goes without saying! I couldn't ask for anything better!」

name: Ria
message: 「Then it's decided♪ How about right after noon?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yes, sounds great. So, is there anywhere in particular you want to go, Senpai?」

name: Ria
message: 「Hmm~~. Since it's your request, Synn-kun, I'll leave it all up to you!」

name: Synn
message: 「Th-Then! Let's meet at the shopping district at 1:00 PM!」

name: Ria
message: 「Sure!」

name: Synn
message: 「Well then, I'm looking forward to our 'date' tomorrow!」

name: Ria
message: 「Huh... A date!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Good night, then!」

name: Ria
message: 「S-Synn-kun!? Wai--」
Haaah... I said it. I actually said I'm going on a date with Ria-senpai!

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey, you've got an awfully happy look on your mug.」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm going on a date with Senpai tomorrow♪」

name: Paqy
message: 「Senpai...? D-Don't tell me you mean you're going on a date with Ria-chan--!?」

name: Paqy
message: 「No, no, hold on, hold on. Calm down, yours truly.」

name: Paqy
message: 「There's no way Synn-sama could ever land a date with Ria-chan. Hehehe... after all, she's head over heels for yours truly.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Which means it's gotta be 'Yoroshiosu.' Oh, so that's what it is. You're pretty slick.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Yeah, good for you. I'm hitting the hay first. Have fun out there.」

name: Synn
message: 「Nighty night~~♪」
Aah, where should we go?
When you think of a date, you walk through a park together, and if things go well, maybe even hold hands...
Khh~~! With my heart pounding this fast, there's no way I can sleep~~!

name: Ria
message: 「So that favor he asked for was a date...」

name: Ria
message: 「Going on a date with a boy... and a younger one at that...」

name: Ria
message: 「I didn't mean for it to be like that... yet, why is it? I'm super happy.」

name: Ria
message: 「N-No way, come on! You dummy, Synn. Asking me on a date all of a sudden is totally a cheap shot!」

name: Ria
message: 「Now I'm gonna be so nervous... tomorrow... I don't even know if I'll be able to act like a proper upperclassman~~!」

name: Ria
message: 「Jeez!」

name: Ria
message: 「Jeez!」

name: Ria
message: 「Haa... haa...」

name: Ria
message: 「...I wonder what outfit I should wear tomorrow...」

name: Ria
message: 「Oh, I know!」

name: Ria
message: 「Big sis~~!」

name: Ria
message: 「Jeez, you're drinking again~~」
